source: The APX7301 is a low-dropout linear regulator in a SOT-23-5 package. Input voltage range: 2.7 V to 5.5 V. Quiescent current is 12 uA typical. Operating temperature: -40 C to +125 C. Absolute maximum input voltage is 6.0 V.
The LRB-4820 wide-input buck controller accepts 4.5 V to 36 V. Shutdown current is 0.8 uA. Quiescent current is 45 uA. It comes in an MSOP-8 package and is rated from -40 C to 150 C.
VX-2210 from Valtex is a 3.0 V to 18 V hot-swap controller. Supply current: 3.5 uA. Package: DFN-6. Junction temperature range -55 C to 125 C.
The NW-1104 load switch operates from 0.9 V to 3.6 V and draws 1.2 uA quiescent current. It is offered in WLCSP-4 and rated -20 C to 85 C.
TRX-6090 is an isolated flyback controller. Input range 8 V to 60 V, typical operating current 150 uA, TO-220-3 package, ambient -40 C to 125 C. Peak current mode control is used.
SXL-3302 is a dual-channel supervisor. It monitors 2.5 V to 16 V rails, consumes 22 uA, ships in SOIC-8, and is specified over -40 C to 105 C. Reset delay is 140 ms.
The HLP-7541 ideal diode controller works from 1.8 V to 5.0 V with 0.35 uA quiescent current. It is packaged in SOT-563 and rated -40 C to 85 C.
MTR-8800 is a 100 V synchronous buck. VIN range 6 V to 100 V, quiescent 90 uA, HTSSOP-16 package, operating junction -40 C to 150 C. Switching frequency up to 2.2 MHz.
QNX-2214 is a USB-C power delivery controller. It accepts 2.9 V to 32 V, draws 7.5 uA in standby, uses QFN-12, and is rated -40 C to 125 C.
BLT-5503 is a nanopower comparator. Supply range 1.1 V to 4.2 V, quiescent current 18 uA, SOT-23-3 package, temperature 0 C to 70 C.
